objections.claim_under_review: BA states that live Playwright inspection found 10 running subagent-control cards with durations 274.0s..518.0s and that fixture/fallback rows expose raw JSON.
objections.evidence_seen_by_qa: BA provides text assertions and code localization, but no saved Playwright snapshot, screenshot, DOM dump, console transcript, or trace artifact for the live UI measurement.
objections.why_this_matters: The claim is central to root cause and acceptance scope. In BA-validation mode QA was instructed not to perform live UI verification, so the BA artifact itself must carry reproducible browser evidence instead of asking downstream agents to trust BA's assertion.
objections.required_ba_fix: Attach or cite concrete live-evidence artifacts for the measured UI claims, e.g. a saved Playwright snapshot/screenshot path showing the running subagent cards and a fixture snapshot showing raw JSON fallback; otherwise downgrade the measurement wording to unverified and add a hard AC requiring QA to capture it.

objections.claim_under_review: BA compresses Section 5.3K safety into generic dev-only/no-production restart wording.
objections.gap: The global spec explicitly requires: do not assume `/root/bin/safe-daemon-restart.sh` exists and verify scripts before citing them. BA's R9/AC5 covers dev-only endpoints and avoiding production restart paths, but omits an acceptance check for the specific safe-daemon script-existence failure that the user challenged.
objections.required_ba_fix: Add a distinct safety acceptance criterion: any restart/reload instruction must first verify the script/path exists in the current environment, must not name `/root/bin/safe-daemon-restart.sh` unless verified, and must preserve the no-production/full-restart rule.
